category_scope: Beauty & Personal Care (hair care, skin care, oral care); general rules where noted
how_brands_deliver_content: Two routes. (1) Ulta Beauty Marketplace (third-party, curated): a brand applies; after approval and signing the Marketplace agreement it uploads products, prices and images with the help of Ulta's onboarding team, and Ulta reviews items before they go live on Ulta.com; the brand ships orders itself from US warehouses. (2) First-party brands: the vendor route and content template are not public (the Ulta supplier page returned an error page). Syndigo offers enhanced content for Ulta product pages ("Engaging Hero" and "In-Line" content) to its brand customers.

languages.note: Not stated in the pages retrieved.

rules.requirement: All Ulta Beauty Marketplace items, including bundles, must have a UPC.

Ulta Beauty Marketplace is not open to everyone: brands are selected, the proposed assortment is reviewed with the Marketplace team against Ulta Beauty product standards, and Ulta reviews items before they go live on Ulta.com.
Marketplace sellers must be US-registered businesses fulfilling from US-based warehouses and shipping within 2 business days.
Bundles sold on Ulta Beauty Marketplace need their own UPC.

enhanced_content.official_name: Enhanced Content & Rich Media (via Syndigo: "Engaging Hero" and "In-Line" content)
enhanced_content.eligibility: Not stated by Ulta publicly; offered to brands through Syndigo.
enhanced_content.modules_note: Syndigo lists 360-degree videos, comparison charts, lifestyle images and interactive content for Ulta product pages. Ulta's own module specifications are not public.

official_quality_signals.notes: No official content or listing-quality score is documented in the public pages that could be retrieved.

limitations: Ulta publishes eligibility and logistics requirements for its Marketplace but no content specification (titles, images, ingredient or claims rules); those are handled with its onboarding team. The first-party vendor content route could not be verified. Enhanced content is attested by a content-partner page only. Web search was unavailable when this retailer was researched (shared search budget exhausted), so discovery relied on directly reachable official and content-partner pages.
